blocks.source_notes: The disappearance is documented; popular embellishments (half-eaten meal, overturned chair, lurid diary entries) are not supported by the primary NLB/National Records of Scotland account. The NLB says McArthur’s wearing coat was left behind; this is distinct from Ducat’s old waterproof coat being away and Marshall’s oilskins. Do not claim the coat proves the sequence of events.
